_pin: Topic set + labels FIXED 2026-06-07 BEFORE any generation (OQ-83 step4 pin 6).
_criterion: contention = two or more agents at the SAME power level with opposed interests in the constraint, identifiable from the topic statement alone, before any DR machinery. Otherwise non_contention.
_label_is_ground_truth: These labels are the gate's control ground truth and are NOT revised against generation output.

topics.label: contention
topics.topic: The app-store commission a dominant mobile platform charges large application publishers for distribution
topics.why_label: platform operator (institutional) and the publisher consortium (institutional) are same-power actors with directly opposed interests over the commission rate

topics.label: contention
